primer: International Gemological Institute Limited (NSE: IGIL) runs a debt-free certification toll-booth with ~65% global lab-grown diamond share. Its 36 labs, 21 schools, AGL, and IGI Botswana earn 69.2% ROCE and 61.4% Q2 margins. Watch flags cover Blackstone's 76.55% stake, FII/DII outflows, 4.52% ESOP dilution, India's margin dip, US diamond tariffs, 1.82% ECL reserves, and GCAL's Mumbai lab. Those headwinds trim our diluted Base Target to ₹480.00 (27.1x FY28E EPS; EV ₹461.25), leaving 0.57:1 R:R at ₹432.50 (2026-11-25 live; ₹431.10 NSE 2026-11-23). We assign Wait for Support (₹380.00–₹395.00 entry on >1.2x volume bounce, ₹349.83 stop, 1.88:1–3.31:1 R:R) and Not Held.
